subject: Seeking help to draw a bar plot

messages.author: ea4e687a14dc225c
messages.subject: Seeking help to draw a bar plot
parts:
Hi, can somebody help to achive following things? Here I have following plot:
 
Dat <- data.frame(Factor=c("CO", "G", "D", "F", "E"),
      x = c(2.50, 0.12, 0.34, 1.22, 0.67)/100)
ggplot(Dat) + geom_bar(aes(x=Factor, y=x, fill=factor(Dat$Factor), legend=F)) + #coord_flip() +
              scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0, 2.7/100), formatter="percent") + xlab(NULL) + ylab(NULL)
 
It is quite okay, however I would like to followings:
 
1. I want to hide the Legend
2. In the plot, order of the bars in not same as the order of "Factor" in my Dat object. It seems that ggplot considers only alphabetical order. How can I put my user defined order?
3. I would like to fill the "unused" part around the boundary of my plot with different color. For example, I want color the space bolow the bars (i.e. below 0%) with some other color. Here I have tried with following code, but could not achive that thing:
 
last_plot() + annotate("rect", xmin=c(-Inf), xmax=c(Inf), ymin=c(-Inf), ymax=c(0), fill="gray94")
 
I would be grateful if somebody help me out on these points.
 
Thanks,

On Sun, Jan 23, 2011 at 4:18 PM, Megh Dal <megh7...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi, can somebody help to achive following things? Here I have following
> plot:
>
> Dat <- data.frame(Factor=c("CO", "G", "D", "F", "E"),
>       x = c(2.50, 0.12, 0.34, 1.22, 0.67)/100)
> ggplot(Dat) + geom_bar(aes(x=Factor, y=x, fill=factor(Dat$Factor),
> legend=F)) + #coord_flip() +
>               scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0, 2.7/100), formatter="percent")
> + xlab(NULL) + ylab(NULL)
>
> It is quite okay, however I would like to followings:
>
> 1. I want to hide the Legend

> 2. In the plot, order of the bars in not same as the order of "Factor" in my
> Dat object. It seems that ggplot considers only alphabetical order. How can
> I put my user defined order?

The order is the same as the order of your factor. You can see this
with levels(Dat$Factor). You can change the order with factor() or
relevel().

Dat$Factor <- reorder(Dat$Factor, Dat$x)

>

> ymax=c(0), fill="gray94")
>
> I would be grateful if somebody help me out on these points.
>
> Thanks,

messages.subject: Re: Seeking help to draw a bar plot
parts: Thanks all, for clarifying 1st 2 questions. In the mean time I have done quite experiements with 3rd question, come to know following code is working:

Dat <- data.frame(Factor=c("CO", "G", "D", "F", "E"),
      x = c(2.50, 0.12, 0.34, 1.22, 0.67)/100)
ggplot(Dat) + geom_bar(aes(x=Factor, y=x, fill=factor(Dat$Factor), legend=F)) + #coord_flip() +
              scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0, 2.7/100), formatter="percent") + xlab(NULL) + ylab(NULL)

last_plot() + geom_rect(aes(xmin=1, xmax=2, ymin=-Inf, ymax=0), fill="black")

However if I put range for "x" as "Inf", everything gets messed up. Like:
 
last_plot() + geom_rect(aes(xmin=-Inf, xmax=Inf, ymin=-Inf, ymax=0), fill="black")
 
Question is why it is working file with y-range but not x-range? Is it just because x-range not numeric? Or is it for some bug there? Really appreciate for any suggestion.
 
Thanks,
